static_traits.name: Chen Bowen
static_traits.marital_status: In a relationship (partner is her boss)
static_traits.social_status: Having friends and family to confide in, but not yet sharing specific worries with them
static_traits.medical_history: without significant physical illness; without psychotherapy / counseling history in the past; similar problems not yet appeared before
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, Good cooperativeness, neutral tone; able to describe concrete situations and automatic thoughts; showing Anxiety and hesitation in new tasks and when observed by partner

basic_info.main_problem: I firmly believe I will never Work in a better place, because I see myself as a person with limited skills. This thinking makes me feel inadequate and dissatisfied in my current Work.
basic_info.core_demands: Realizing that beliefs about her own skills and career prospects are affecting Work satisfaction and overall well-being, hoping to change these negative beliefs.
growth_experiences: Not yet promoted about a year ago, subsequently developing persistent 'I am not good enough, limited ability' self-evaluations and inadequacy; after her boss became her partner, this inadequacy intensified, feeling she may both receive special treatment and must try harder to prove herself, further doubting her own ability.

Multiple successful deals or effectively helping clients at Work and receiving clients' thanks and recognition; but when reviewing achievements often feeling these successes 'few and unstable', hard to maintain confidence, negative thinking covering over when meeting new challenges.

core_beliefs: I am a person of limited ability
I am not smart enough / not competent enough
I am an 'impostor', I will be seen through at any time

special_situations.event: Not yet passed promotion a year ago
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I have not been promoted, it shows I am not good enough, not deserving a better position
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Doubling down on skill improvement, seeking comfort and recognition from partner (boss)
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not good enough, I will never Work in a better place

special_situations.event: When handling new real-estate transaction tasks
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot quickly master new tasks, it shows I am incompetent, will fail
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding asking for help to not appear weak; repeatedly self-checking, hesitating
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will mess up, others are more competent than me

special_situations.event: The partner (boss) observes from the side or pays attention to my work performance
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If my performance before him is not perfect, he will see through my incompetence and look down on me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries harder to prove oneself, seeking their affirmation and reassurance
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: He will discover I lack ability / will look down on me

special_situations.event: When reviewing Work performance focusing more on mistakes and inadequacy while ignoring successes
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only sustained, frequent successes count as truly capable, scattered successes do not count
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Focuses on errors and negative cues, downplays positive feedback
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: These successes were just luck, not representing my ability

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized as competent and reliable, and to obtain better career opportunities and a stable, supportive intimate relationship
core_conflict.fear: Fearing failure exposing incompetence, suffering belittlement / rejection, status and relationship damaged
defense_goal: Avoiding exposing incompetence to gain a sense of security
Reducing the risk of failure through Self-monitoring and avoidance

object_relations.self_representation: Not competent enough, an 'impostor' easily exposed
object_relations.object_representation: Supervisors / partners who scrutinize and judge, who may see through and belittle her at any time

object_relations.self_representation: Second-class subordinate who needs to prove oneself

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the partner (boss) is present observing or evaluating work performance
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Projecting one's own shame and sense of incompetence as the other's negative evaluation and scrutiny (transference: Projection)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Tense tone, over-explains and proves oneself, avoids asking for help so as not to appear weak.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to view the relationship between 'ability and perfection' from an alternative perspective (e.g.: one can be competent without being perfect)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Tending to discuss problems through rational analysis, downplaying or isolating uncomfortable emotions to maintain a sense of control
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Respond with rational, analytical statements, lowering emotional intensity and avoiding deep emotional experience.

manifestations: Believing one can never Work in a better place
Viewing oneself with the label 'limited ability'
Decreased work motivation, finding it hard to maintain confidence
outcomes: Avoiding asking for help and excessive Self-monitoring

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: Believing 'one must not appear weak', thus avoiding asking for help
Feeling one must constantly prove oneself more capable

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Self-doubt intensifies when observed by partner (supervisor), with repeated self-checking and hesitation
Overly cautious when facing new tasks; second-guesses decisions

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on.
manifestations: Worrying that partner/colleagues will look down on oneself or see through one's incompetence
Interpreting inner shame and unease as others' negative evaluations

exception_events.target_problem: When facing new Work challenges or being observed by partner (supervisor), the client usually experiences Self-doubt, predicts failure and avoids asking for help, leading to impaired performance and decreased confidence.
exception_events.unique_outcome: In some past property transactions, the client successfully closed deals and received clear thanks and recognition from clients; at the time experiencing some confidence and sense of competence, different from the Self-doubt in usual new-task situations.
exception_events.reason: Clues: receiving positive feedback and recognition from clients; tasks better matching existing experience and skills; being better able to focus on concrete controllable steps in that situation, thus reducing Self-doubt.

positive_force: Has experience of successful deals and client recognition
Willing to try improving skills and doing cognitive restructuring
Able to notice negative thoughts and actively seek counseling
Has some social support resources (friends and family)
negative_force: Predicting failure (Fortune Telling) and mind reading of others' evaluations (Mind Reading)
Mental filtering and devaluing positive evidence (Mental Filtering/negating the positive)
Avoiding asking for help so as not to appear weak, excessive Self-monitoring
Dependence on external recognition (seeking a partner's / supervisor's reassurance and affirmation)

target_behavior.behavior: Excessive Self-doubt and avoidance of asking for help in Work situations (accompanied by significant anxiety and second-guessing)
antecedent: Recalling the situation of not yet being promoted and related evaluations
target_behavior.core_reason: Overgeneralizing one failure to be promoted as one's own incompetence, strongly relying on external evaluation and fearing failure being seen through, thus forming catastrophic predictions and mind-reading others' negative views.
target_behavior.function: Avoiding the risk of being judged and exposing incompetence, maintaining surface image and relationship security.
target_behavior.consequence: Declining Work satisfaction and performance, impaired motivation and self-esteem, limited career development.
